nodes.name: PDF Inspector
nodes.summary: Native PDF inspection tool used to extract selectable text, layout, tables, and page positions without OCR.

nodes.name: Docling
nodes.summary: Document conversion tool used with OCR, VLM, and model enrichments disabled.

nodes.name: LangExtract
nodes.summary: Extraction component whose returned values require valid character intervals and exact source-text matches.

nodes.name: GLM-OCR
nodes.summary: Existing local OCR engine that owns recognized layout and geometry for scanned documents.

nodes.name: PaddleOCR-VL
nodes.summary: Existing local OCR engine that owns recognized layout and geometry for scanned documents.

nodes.name: Streamlit
nodes.summary: Application framework providing per-file processing selection and Mixed-PDF route review.

nodes.name: Every upload requires an explicit processing selection
nodes.summary: The UI requires a processing type for each uploaded file and accepts it only after file validation.

nodes.name: Persistence preserves evidence identity
nodes.summary: Reloading native results must preserve character offsets and evidence identity instead of reconstructing them from Markdown.

nodes.name: Docling conversion is non-OCR
nodes.summary: Docling OCR, VLM processing, and model enrichments are disabled so converted text remains traceable to source structure.

nodes.name: Mixed-PDF routing is reviewed and fail-closed
nodes.summary: Users confirm or override each suggested page route, results retain original page order, and no silent route fallback occurs.

nodes.name: Unusable native pages require Mixed PDF
nodes.summary: Native PDF processing stops and recommends Mixed PDF when inspection finds pages that cannot serve as native evidence.

nodes.name: OCR recovery cannot alter document structure
nodes.summary: Visual recovery may replace text within existing elements but cannot create, delete, reorder, or re-geometry elements.

nodes.name: Native structure becomes source evidence
nodes.summary: Validated native formats map paragraphs, shapes, cells, tables, rows, and columns to source units and anchors; embedded media is recorded but not OCRed.

nodes.name: Accepted native values require exact evidence
nodes.summary: A value is accepted only with a valid interval, exact source-text match, complete span coverage, and a resolvable anchor.

nodes.name: User selection controls exactly one pipeline
nodes.summary: Each validated file selection reaches one top-level pipeline with no automatic reinterpretation after validation fails.

edges.description: The Streamlit workflow concretely implements required per-file processing selection.
Workspace serialization and restoration exemplify preservation of grounded evidence identity.
The Docling adapter implements the stated non-OCR conversion boundary.
The mixed pipeline is the concrete reviewed-routing implementation.
The native PDF parser enforces the unusable-page stop condition.
The recovery path concretely applies the structural limits.
The supported format mapping is the concrete source-structure evidence design.
The product contract states the acceptance conditions for grounded values.
The routing article defines the authoritative selection and single-pipeline behavior.
